{{Quote|Piracy is expected to be dealt with by the individuals traveling these space lanes. Normally, they don't cause too much trouble. But this one has become a problem. Not content with taking cargo, he has destroyed a number of transports in the last few weeks and shows no signs of stopping.|[[Belga Daeri]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:BD" />}}
'''Dorn Nareusu''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Dorn Nareusu and his band of [[Asteroid Bandits|Mining Pirates]] raided and destroyed numerous [[Transport/Legends|transport ships]] in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]].<ref name="SWG:BD" /> Nareusu himself piloted an [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170 starfighter]].<ref name="SWG:DA" /> After several weeks of rampage, the pirates had seriously disturbed the civilian traffic in the system.<ref name="SWG:BD" /> Around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], [[Belga Daeri]], an official at the [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]] [[Kachirho Starport|spaceport]], placed a [[Death mark/Legends|death mark]] on Dorn Nareusu via [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Bounty/Legends|Bounty]] [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[Stren Colo]].<ref name="SWG:BD" /> Since Nareusu was not based in the system, a group of pilots therefore attacked Nareusu's cohorts in the Kashyyyk system to attract the pirate to the system.<ref name="SWG:DDC" /> As expected, Dorn Nareusu later arrived in the system to join the fight. He was eventually killed in the ensuing battle.<ref name="SWG:DA" />
